experiment: Matched history lengths and fusion architectures, five fixed seeds, PINNS leave-one-site-out, CPU

models.M1b: Implicit gate, no continuous quality input; pose presence retained
models.M1-concat: Learned bias-free projection of concatenated motion and available pose; missing pose bypass

protocol.splits: Hold out one entire site, train on the other three, use the last epoch. All four sites had been seen during development.
protocol.metrics: Highest model probability selects one of six candidate trajectories. ADE covers 30 true future steps; FDE uses the exact final step. Units are metres. Within a site each window has equal weight; average four sites, then average the five paired seed results separately.

quality.scope: Secondary cross-seed matched-cohort decomposition, specified before opening any new extension fit or prediction. Seed 42 was previously examined.
quality.grouping: Assign once on each of the 623 matched windows using the original cache's last five observed positions/crops, existing build_pose_and_quality_features and assign_quality_bucket. Apply those exact same class labels to histories of length 5, 10 and 20. Fixed clear/partial/heavy counts are 188/283/152. Published mutually exclusive implementation resolves overlapping/incomplete literal proposal conditions. These are estimated pose-quality groups and do not establish physical or obstacle-caused occlusion.
quality.report: Within each duration and fixed bin, report windows, clips and positive coverage per physical site as applicable; per seed and across seeds give site-equal, within-site window-weighted paired ADE/FDE differences M1 minus M0 and M1 minus M1b. Display each seed and across-seed arithmetic mean with sample spread for the five specified seeds. Retain all estimable sites; require all four for four-site macro; no generalization claim to the population of sites.
quality.seed42_once: Use verified seed-42 matched 5 and 10 results and the same-worker four-arm 20-frame control when available. Earlier 20-frame different-host fits are supplementary; do not count a replay or repeated fit of seed 42 as an additional seed.

processor_controls.frame_mapping: Frozen pilot clock, raw image index = 3 * sampled observation index.

provenance.four_new_seed_training: For each new seed, all three histories, four models, four folds were fitted on a single Kaggle Intel CPU allocation. There were separate allocations between seeds. All four list Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU @ 2.20GHz, PyTorch 2.11.0+cpu, four intra-op threads, deterministic algorithms.
provenance.hardware_scope: Seed 42 alone uses previous separate Intel sessions for the two base vs fusion model pairs at T5/T10. Its T20 contains all four arms on one Intel allocation. Its earlier mixed-host T20 fits are excluded. Four new seeds provide a one-worker-per-seed replication.

verification.checked: All new archive CRCs, member SHA-256, fold keys and complements, original cache inputs/truth, state SHA-256, six trajectories/probabilities, top-1 ADE/FDE, per-site metrics and equal-site means were checked. Seed 42 reuses its previously verified artifacts and each arm contributes once.

imprecision: Five fixed training-seed SDs quantify fitting variation. Supplementary descriptive 20,000 paired clip bootstrap percentile intervals sample the same whole clips for all arms within each of four fixed sites, then average site means. Site identities and five fitted seeds are held fixed; this interval omits variation across new sites and new seeds. No multiple-comparison correction.
